#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    long long val;
    std::cin >> val;
    int digits = (int)(std::log10(std::abs(val)) + 1);
    
    auto makeOnes = [](long long count) -> long long {
        return ( ( (long long) std::pow(10, count) ) - 1 ) / 9;
    };
    
    std::function<long long(long long, int)> process = [&](long long n, int len) -> long long {
        long long ones = makeOnes(len);
        long long totalCount = (n / ones) * len;
        n %= ones;
        if (n == 0) return totalCount;
        long long option1 = (len + 1) + process(ones - n, len - 1);
        long long option2 = process(n, len - 1);
        return totalCount + std::min(option1, option2);
    };
    
    std::cout << process(val, digits) << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
